summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Universal Lost & Found Recovery (Findr). 22/22 backend pytest cases passing across auth, uploads, reports CRUD, matching algorithm, notifications, NGO cases, stats. Frontend smoke covering landing, login (admin/NGO), signup (user), dashboard, /reports, /map (leaflet), /my-reports, /notifications, /report/lost (form + map picker), /ngo route, role-based nav visibility, and logout — all working.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True. Browsers may reject this combo for cross-origin cookie auth. Currently OK because frontend & backend share the same host (preview ingress). Set explicit origins for production.
Endpoint allows public read of any uploaded image (no ACL). Documented intentional, but flag for production hardening.
FastAPI route function name 'refresh' shadows JWT variable name; works but cosmetic risk.

issues: Demo accounts box exposes admin/NGO credentials in plain text — fine for staging, must be removed before production
Benign 401s logged on landing/login pages from /api/auth/me probe; consider suppressing the error log when 401 is the expected unauthenticated state

action_items: (Optional) Tighten CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit frontend origin for production
(Optional) Remove demo credentials block on /login before production
(Optional) Suppress noisy 401 console errors from /auth/me on unauthenticated routes
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~930 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, reports, ngo, uploads, storage) for maintainability
Match notifications + /matches loop scan all reports of opposite type per insert (O(N)); add geospatial 2dsphere index + bounding-box prefilter for scale
Delete cascade only removes notifications/matches for owner-deleted reports but not nearby alerts referencing that report_id (acceptable but worth noting)
seed_user updates password hash if changed — good; admin role correctly preserved
bcrypt hash format confirmed $2b$ via login round-trip; httpOnly cookies set with secure+samesite=none
Brute-force lockout (5 attempts → 15-min lock) verified by code review (not load-tested to avoid locking the shared admin)

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (login admin/NGO, signup user, dashboard, /reports, /map leaflet, /my-reports, /notifications, /report/lost form+map, /ngo route, role-based nav visibility, logout)

test_credentials: admin@findr.app/admin123, ngo@findr.app/ngo123 (both seeded and verified). Test user registered dynamically per run.
seed_data_creation: Tests dynamically register a fresh user each run (test_user_<uuid>@findr.app) and clean up reports they create.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_findr_api.py is reusable as regression. Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_findr_api.py -v. Matching threshold is score>=50 for notifications and >=30 for /matches. For matching tests use same entity_type+color and lat/lng <1km. NGO route requires role in {ngo, admin}; admin also passes role checks for NGO endpoints by design.
rca of the issue: No bugs found — implementation matches the spec end-to-end.
